immutable_basis: crossing_map_target_v1 remains unchanged; its exposed development week is not a fresh holdout
question: Can factorization, proper probability losses and shared/private representations improve learning efficiency without changing an opportunity map into an unjustified OPEN label?
primary_target: Keep BB M1/M3/M6 amplitude >=2R by 300s, NONE/LONG_ONLY/SHORT_ONLY/BOTH, the frozen decision-time R and maturity rules. VWAP and M5 are separate ablations, not a pooled retrospective winner.
semantic_constraints: At a common checkpoint, NL-NS=2*delta(mid); NL+NS=-(entry_spread+exit_spread+2*fee). Net sides are not exact negatives.
After searching different future checkpoints, both side opportunities may exist; pS is not 1-pL.
An actually complementary side task does not automatically cause gradient conflict in a shared encoder.
A favorable checkpoint is not an executable exit rule or account value.

probability_baseline.loss: BCE(E)+1[E=1]CE(L_ONLY,S_ONLY,BOTH|E), averaged over a common admitted root cohort
probability_baseline.alternative: Two Bernoulli side heads learn marginals but do not identify their joint probability or BOTH. Do not assume conditional independence without evidence.
probability_baseline.direction_mask: Use observed mature target E to define conditional supervision. Do not multiply direction CE by the trainable predicted pE: lowering pE could avoid that loss.
probability_baseline.censoring: Initial BCE/CE positives and negatives share the same fully mature cohort. Partial-witness facts are retained, not mixed selectively with mature negatives. Survival treatment needs specified censoring assumptions.

loss_candidates.baseline: Unweighted BCE/CE; no inverse-frequency correction by default
loss_candidates.proper_hybrid: (1-lambda)*BCE+lambda*Brier, lambda in {0,0.25,0.5}; choose on internal chronological validation. Current analytic probe uses lambda=0.5.
loss_candidates.proper_confidence_probe: For epsilon=1/3, BCE-4/3*(p-y)^2 has logit gradient (p-y)*(1/3+2/3*(2p-1)^2). This remains proper but suppresses near-half-probability gradients; no benefit on market data is established.
loss_candidates.focal: Gamma in {0,0.5,1,2}; begin with equal class weights. Only after gradient-mass evidence, compare positive/negative weight ratio {0.5,1,2}, normalized by mean FIT weight. Gamma and class weights selected jointly; never stack uncorrected oversampling and large class weights.
loss_candidates.focal_schedule: Optional controlled ablation: begin with gamma=0 then ramp to selected gamma during first10% of steps. This is a hypothesis, not a literature-guaranteed optimum. Always retain a fixed-gamma comparator.
loss_candidates.focal_calibration: Use raw scores for ranking only until probability calibration is checked on a separate chronological calibration set. Temperature or logistic calibration is not guaranteed to undo all misspecification. Do not apply focal to survival hazards by default.
loss_candidates.auxiliary: Line-addressed survival NLL and conditional net/MAE quantile losses; optional monotone gain-threshold ordinal heads. Do not impose ordinal order on named crossing lines or mutually exclusive competition on all line events.
loss_candidates.not_default: ASL/GCE, future-profit weights, label smoothing, ranking-only loss and temporal smoothing require a separately specified estimand; they are not automatic noise removal.

sharing_candidates: One shared encoder with coherent E/D and time/risk heads
One weight-shared side-conditioned encoder with explicit mirrored feature contract
Shared early representation plus private side adapters or towers
Two independent encoders, both trained with all relevant positive AND negative roots
split_model_trigger: Persistent harmful per-task gradients together with repeated held-out degradation versus side-specific fits after weighting/capacity controls. Negative cosine alone is insufficient. Compare GradNorm for magnitude imbalance, PCGrad for conflict, private towers for different useful representations.

context_and_backbones.input_contract: Matched fast flow/DOM history, slow causal M1 context through current and previous London session, VWAP/band/STFT context, availability masks and elapsed time. Equal target definitions and data clocks for CNN/TCN/LSTM/Mamba-2.
context_and_backbones.CNN: Causal local receptive field must be computed; book-side filters and multiscale branches can be shared. A local model is a local-context control, not an equal long-context comparison.
context_and_backbones.TCN: Causal dilated convolutions; record exact receptive field. With two stride1 k3 convolutions per block and dilations 1..2^(B-1), R=1+4*(2^B-1) tokens.
context_and_backbones.LSTM: Record sequence length, burn-in, state carry/reset and gradient truncation. Existing MixedPlayer has 900s fast and up to2760 M1 states with causal retrieval, but is not a crossing-target benchmark.
context_and_backbones.Mamba2: Record actual Mamba-2 version/kernel, state dimension, chunk/state-carry semantics, masks and numerical precision. Long streaming memory is compressed; it is not a guarantee of remembering yesterday or a trading advantage.

opportunity_utilization.semantic_contract: Same opportunity meaning across all architectures
opportunity_utilization.three_roles: Auxiliary representation supervision; coherent joint probability factor; optional high-recall inference router. Report which role is active.
opportunity_utilization.model_specific: Calibrator, operating threshold, head gradient scale, state/receptive-field settings and compute budget may differ; targets must remain fixed for comparison.
opportunity_utilization.routing: No early hard predicted gate during fitting. If a separate model consumes opportunity predictions, use chronological out-of-fold predictions for its FIT inputs, never future true E or in-sample scores presented as held-out.
opportunity_utilization.adaptation: Update calibrators or policy thresholds only from already mature past outcomes; account for target delay and changed selection prevalence. No automatic online updating implemented here.

staged_comparison: Freeze chronology, coverage, target/maturity and geometric baseline; count repeated physical events inside FIT only
Compare flat four-state CE, coherent E/D, and two marginal heads on one fixed encoder and identical cohorts
Compare shared, side-conditioned, private-tower and separate models with matched total parameters/compute; also report equal-per-side-capacity diagnostic
Introduce focal or proper hybrid only on the best-supported setup; isolate loss from target and architecture changes
Compare CNN/TCN/LSTM/Mamba-2 with matched accessible context and trained budget; report latency/VRAM and OOS signal use
Freeze calibration and thresholds before sequential account replay; compare after-cost equity separately
measurements: Proper NLL/Brier, classwise and sidewise reliability, PR-AUC plus prevalence, recall at matched acceptance rate, repeated-event/day clustered uncertainty; report both natural-clock and event-weighted populations
Head/block gradient norms, paired-task gradient cosine distributions, gradient mass by easy/hard/near-threshold/repeated-event cohorts, not only scalar loss
Prediction stability around events, time CDF calibration, quantile coverage and gain-before-stop ordering
Past-only removal or permutation ablations of previous-session context, fast flow, bands and STFT; gradient/saliency alone is insufficient
Accepted-set calibration and net/MAE under causal exit rules, trade count, costs, drawdown and capital growth
admission: No trained architecture ranking, no measured negative transfer, no optimal gamma, no profitable policy established by this research.
